fields.recording_path: Relative path under the private corpus root. Never commit raw audio to git.
fields.consent_id: Consent/provenance reference controlled outside the repo.
fields.speaker_id: Pseudonymous speaker id; must be stable enough for speaker-disjoint splits.
fields.device_type: phone_mic | pixel_buds | watch | glasses | local_android_peer | other
fields.capture_path: ambient_audio | buds_audio | watch_audio | glasses_audio | device_audio | local_network
fields.environment: home | office | car | street | cafe | meeting | noisy_public | quiet | other
fields.transcript: Verbatim transcript if speech is present.
fields.primary_label: timer | list | search | calendar | person | event | device_control | near_miss | speech_non_command | ambient_non_speech | human_non_speech
fields.secondary_labels: Optional array of extra labels from label-map.json.
fields.intent_slots: Optional object for timer/list/search/calendar/person/event slot labels.
fields.near_miss_terms: Trigger-like words present in a non-command utterance.

quality_gates: No clip enters train/val/test until review_state is reviewed.
No clip enters gold_eval unless captured on target-like hardware or local Android peer.
Gold eval must be speaker-disjoint and device-disjoint from train.
Synthetic positives cannot replace first-party positives for a head marked critical.
